title: H2O, RHF/STO-3G, full valence window
description: The smallest closed-shell case. Every quantity is cheap enough to obtain exactly, so this is where the frozen-core algebra is checked before anything else runs.

active_space.notes: The O 1s is the only frozen orbital; nothing is frozen above the window.

solver.notes: Small enough for exact diagonalisation, so this entry doubles as the truth source for the solver adapters.

provenance.geometry_source: gaussian/probe_h2o_rhf.gjf, the committed M0 probe job.
provenance.notes: Deliberately identical to the M0 probe so the first real .mat available can be used here without a new Gaussian run.
